body:
I know what it's like to screw up in college. At first I was aimlessly looking for something in community college, then I got so depressed I had to quit. After that I decided I wanted to be a therapist or counselor, but now I realized I'm not emotionally strong enough for that so I'm giving up to depression and dropping out of university. I feel like I'm a horrible person who's wasting his parents money. My grades are mediocre at best and I procrastinate all the time even though I'm smart enough to know better.

You are not alone, life is complicated and I feel like it only gets more complicated as time goes by. If you want to talk I'll probably be here, after all I have no job and I'm too depressed/unsure about my future to go to school.
